headline: Simba system review surfaced 3 critical weaknesses in message reliability
body: The network agent completed a system review of Simba and identified critical issues with the action ledger—it cannot guarantee exactly-once external effects when sessions revive after network drops. A send can succeed remotely, then the session crashes before recording the receipt; on revival, the operation retries and fires twice. Local idempotency alone doesn't solve this. The simba session is still running (untitled work). The issues found are architectural, not edge cases.
needs_decision: Does the team accept the current exactly-once limitation, or should this be fixed before shipping? It affects any remote mutation (sends, updates) that matters.
